approve(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-approve}. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address.

collectInterest().details: Converts recently accrued swap and redeem fees into mAsset

returns.mintAmount: mAsset units generated from swap and redeem fees

collectPlatformInterest().details: Collects the interest generated from the Basket, minting a relative      amount of mAsset and sends it over to the SavingsManager.

returns.mintAmount: mAsset units generated from interest collected from lending markets

decimals().details: Returns the number of decimals used to get its user representation. For example, if `decimals` equals `2`, a balance of `505` tokens should be displayed to a user as `5,05` (`505 / 10 ** 2`). Tokens usually opt for a value of 18, imitating the relationship between Ether and Wei. NOTE: This information is only used for _display_ purposes: it in no way affects any of the arithmetic of the contract, including {IERC20-balanceOf} and {IERC20-transfer}.

decreaseAllowance(address,uint256).details: Atomically decreases the allowance granted to `spender` by the caller. This is an alternative to {approve} that can be used as a mitigation for problems described in {IERC20-approve}. Emits an {Approval} event indicating the updated allowance. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address. - `spender` must have allowance for the caller of at least `subtractedValue`.

getBasset(address).details: Get data for a specific bAsset, if it exists

getBassets().details: Get data for a all bAssets in basket

returns.data: Number of bAssets in the Basket

getConfig().details: Gets all config needed for general InvariantValidator calls

getMintMultiOutput(address[],uint256[]).details: Get the projected output of a given mint

params._inputQuantities: Quantity of each bAsset to deposit for the minted mAsset.
params._inputs: Non-duplicate address array of addresses to bAssets to deposit for the minted mAsset tokens.

returns.mintOutput: Estimated mint output in mAsset terms

getMintOutput(address,uint256).details: Get the projected output of a given mint

params._input: Address of the bAsset to deposit for the minted mAsset

returns.mintOutput: Estimated mint output in mAsset terms

params._outputs: Addresses of the bAsset to receive

returns.mAssetQuantity: Estimated quantity of mAsset units needed to burn to receive output

params._output: Address of the bAsset to receive

returns.bAssetOutput: Estimated quantity of bAsset units received for the burnt mAssets

getSwapOutput(address,address,uint256).details: Determines both if a trade is valid, and the expected fee or output. Swap is valid if it does not result in the input asset exceeding its maximum weight.

params._inputQuantity: Units of input bAsset to swap

returns.swapOutput: Quantity of output asset returned from swap

handlePegLoss(address,bool).details: Executes the Auto Redistribution event by isolating the bAsset from the Basket

params._bAsset: Address of the ERC20 token to isolate
params._belowPeg: Bool to describe whether the bAsset deviated below peg (t)                         or above (f)

increaseAllowance(address,uint256).details: Atomically increases the allowance granted to `spender` by the caller. This is an alternative to {approve} that can be used as a mitigation for problems described in {IERC20-approve}. Emits an {Approval} event indicating the updated allowance. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address.

migrateBassets(address[],address).details: Transfers all collateral from one lending market to another - used initially      to handle the migration between Aave V1 and Aave V2. Note - only supports non      tx fee enabled assets. Supports going from no integration to integration, but      not the other way around.

params._bAssets: Array of basket assets to migrate
params._newIntegration: Address of the new platform integration

mint(address,uint256,uint256,address).details: Mint a single bAsset, at a 1:1 ratio with the bAsset. This contract      must have approval to spend the senders bAsset

params._input: Address of the bAsset to deposit for the minted mAsset.
params._minOutputQuantity: Minimum mAsset quanity to be minted. This protects against slippage.
params._recipient: Receipient of the newly minted mAsset tokens

returns.mintOutput: Quantity of newly minted mAssets for the deposited bAsset.

mintMulti(address[],uint256[],uint256,ad.details: Mint with multiple bAssets, at a 1:1 ratio to mAsset. This contract      must have approval to spend the senders bAssets

params._inputQuantities: Quantity of each bAsset to deposit for the minted mAsset.                           Order of array should mirror the above bAsset addresses.
params._inputs: Non-duplicate address array of bASset addresses to deposit for the minted mAsset tokens.
params._minOutputQuantity: Minimum mAsset quanity to be minted. This protects against slippage.
params._recipient: Address to receive the newly minted mAsset tokens

returns.mintOutput: Quantity of newly minted mAssets for the deposited bAssets.

name().details: Returns the name of the token.

negateIsolation(address).details: Negates the isolation of a given bAsset

params._minOutputQuantity: Minimum bAsset quantity to receive for the burnt mAssets. This protects against slippage.
params._output: Address of the bAsset to receive
params._recipient: Address to transfer the withdrawn bAssets to.

returns.outputQuantity: Quanity of bAsset units received for the burnt mAssets

redeemExactBassets(address[],uint256[],u.details: Credits a recipient with a certain quantity of selected bAssets, in exchange for burning the      relative Masset quantity from the sender. Sender also incurs a small fee on the outgoing asset.

params._maxMassetQuantity: Maximum mAsset quantity to burn for the received bAssets. This protects against slippage.
params._outputQuantities: Units of the bAssets to redeem
params._outputs: Addresses of the bAssets to receive
params._recipient: Address to receive the withdrawn bAssets

returns.mAssetQuantity: Quantity of mAsset units burned plus the swap fee to pay for the redeemed bAssets

redeemMasset(uint256,uint256[],address).details: Credits a recipient with a proportionate amount of bAssets, relative to current vault balance levels and desired mAsset quantity. Burns the mAsset as payment.

params._minOutputQuantities: Min units of output to receive
params._recipient: Address to credit the withdrawn bAssets

setCacheSize(uint256).details: Sets the MAX cache size for each bAsset. The cache will actually revolve around      _cacheSize * totalSupply / 2 under normal circumstances.

params._cacheSize: Maximum percent of total mAsset supply to hold for each bAsset

setFees(uint256,uint256).details: Set the ecosystem fee for sewapping bAssets or redeeming specific bAssets

setTransferFeesFlag(address,bool).details: Update transfer fee flag for a given bAsset, should it change its fee practice

params._flag: Charge transfer fee when its set to 'true', otherwise 'false'

setWeightLimits(uint128,uint128).details: Set the maximum weight for a given bAsset

startRampA(uint256,uint256).details: Starts changing of the amplification var A

params._rampEndTime: Time at which A will arrive at _targetA

stopRampA().details: Stops the changing of the amplification var A, setting it to whatever the current value is.

swap(address,address,uint256,uint256,add.details: Swaps one bAsset for another bAsset using the bAsset addresses. bAsset <> bAsset swaps will incur a small fee (swapFee()).

params._inputQuantity: Units of input bAsset to swap
params._minOutputQuantity: Minimum quantity of the swap output asset. This protects against slippage
params._recipient: Address to transfer output asset to

returns.swapOutput: Quantity of output asset returned from swap

symbol().details: Returns the symbol of the token, usually a shorter version of the name.

transfer(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transfer}. Requirements: - `recipient` cannot be the zero address. - the caller must have a balance of at least `amount`.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transferFrom}. Emits an {Approval} event indicating the updated allowance. This is not required by the EIP. See the note at the beginning of {ERC20}. Requirements: - `sender` and `recipient` cannot be the zero address. - `sender` must have a balance of at least `amount`. - the caller must have allowance for ``sender``'s tokens of at least `amount`.

upgrade(address,(uint256,(uint128,uint12.details: Upgrades mUSD from v2.0 to v3.0.      This function should be called via Proxy just after the proxy has been updated.

params._config: Configutation for the invariant validator including the                         amplification coefficient (A) and weight limits

upgradeForgeValidator(address).details: Upgrades the version of ForgeValidator protocol. Governor can do this      only while ForgeValidator is unlocked.

devdoc.title: Masset used to migrate mUSD from V2.0 to V3.0

getRedeemExactBassetsOutput(address[],ui.notice: Gets the estimated output from a given redeem

getRedeemOutput(address,uint256).notice: Gets the estimated output from a given redeem

redeem(address,uint256,uint256,address).notice: Redeems a specified quantity of mAsset in return for a bAsset specified by bAsset address. The bAsset is sent to the specified recipient. The bAsset quantity is relative to current vault balance levels and desired mAsset quantity. The quantity of mAsset is burnt as payment. A minimum quantity of bAsset is specified to protect against price slippage between the mAsset and bAsset.

userdoc.notice: An incentivised constant sum market maker with hard limits at max region. This supports          low slippage swaps and applies penalties towards min and max regions. AMM produces a          stablecoin (mAsset) and redirects lending market interest and swap fees to the savings          contract, producing a second yield bearing asset.
